posts.title: Style Navigation
posts.content: Use heading styles (Ctrl + Alt + 1/2/3) for document structure. Then Ctrl + Click in TOC to jump anywhere!

posts.title: Multi-Cursor Editing
posts.content: Alt + Click adds cursor anywhere. Ctrl + Alt + Up/Down adds cursor above/below. Edits everywhere at once!

posts.title: Lock Screen Fast
posts.content: Windows: Win + L locks screen. Mac: Cmd + Ctrl + Q. Essential for office security!

posts.title: Split Editor
posts.content: Ctrl + \ splits editor. Ctrl + 1/2/3 focuses different editor groups. Great for side-by-side coding!

posts.title: Word Count Shortcut
posts.content: Select text and Ctrl + Shift + G shows word count. No need to check status bar!

posts.title: Force Quit Menu
posts.content: Cmd + Option + Esc opens Force Quit menu when apps freeze. Lifesaver!

posts.title: Virtual Desktops
posts.content: Use Win + Tab to create multiple desktops. Win + Ctrl + D creates new desktop, Win + Ctrl + Left/Right switches between them.

posts.title: Spotlight is Powerful
posts.content: Cmd + Space for Spotlight, then type math equations, unit conversions, or file names. It's like a mini calculator!

posts.title: Quick Sum
posts.content: Select cells and look at bottom right status bar - shows sum without formula! Alt + = also creates SUM formula automatically.

posts.title: Find and Replace Power
posts.content: Ctrl + H for find/replace. Use wildcards for advanced patterns. Can replace formatting too!

posts.title: Command Palette
posts.content: Ctrl + Shift + P opens command palette. Access every feature without memorizing shortcuts!

posts.title: Hidden Dock Trick
posts.content: Cmd + Option + D toggles dock auto-hide. More screen space for work!

posts.title: Flash Fill Magic
posts.content: Type a pattern in first two cells, then Ctrl+E to auto-fill the rest. Excel learns the pattern!

posts.title: Search Tabs
posts.content: Ctrl + Shift + A searches through all open tabs. Perfect when you have 50+ tabs!

posts.title: Clipboard History
posts.content: Windows: Win + V shows clipboard history! Mac: use built-in or third-party apps. Game changer for copying multiple things.

posts.title: Quick Settings
posts.content: Windows: Win + I opens Settings instantly. Mac: Cmd + , opens app preferences in most apps.

posts.title: Zen Mode
posts.content: Ctrl + K then Z enters Zen mode - fullscreen, no distractions. Press Esc twice to exit.

posts.title: Screenshot Like a Pro
posts.content: Cmd + Shift + 4 lets you select area for screenshot. Add Ctrl to copy to clipboard instead of saving file.

posts.title: Incognito Quickly
posts.content: Ctrl + Shift + N opens incognito window instantly. No menu clicking needed.

posts.title: Bookmark All Tabs
posts.content: Ctrl + Shift + D bookmarks all open tabs in a folder. Great for research sessions!

posts.title: Mission Control
posts.content: Three finger swipe up on trackpad or F3 shows all windows. Makes multitasking so much easier!

posts.title: Emoji Anywhere
posts.content: Windows: Win + . (period) opens emoji picker. Mac: Cmd + Ctrl + Space. Works in any app!

posts.title: Screenshot Annotations
posts.content: Windows: Win + Shift + S for Snip & Sketch. Mac: Cmd + Shift + 5 has markup tools built-in.

posts.title: Navigate Large Sheets
posts.content: Ctrl + Arrow keys jumps to edge of data. Ctrl + Home returns to A1 instantly.

posts.title: Tab Management
posts.content: Ctrl + T for new tab, Ctrl + W to close, Ctrl + Shift + T reopens closed tabs! Can reopen multiple tabs in order.

posts.title: Developer Tools
posts.content: F12 or Ctrl + Shift + I opens DevTools. Ctrl + Shift + C for element inspector.

posts.title: Navigation Pane
posts.content: Ctrl + F opens navigation pane in Word. Shows document outline and instant search results.

posts.title: Master Copy-Paste
posts.content: Don't just use Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V. Try Ctrl+Shift+V for paste without formatting - saves tons of time!

posts.title: Task Manager Shortcut
posts.content: Ctrl + Shift + Esc opens Task Manager directly without the security screen. Much faster!

posts.title: Format Painter
posts.content: Double-click Format Painter (Ctrl + Shift + C) to copy formatting to multiple places. Click once to turn off.

posts.title: Window Snapping Pro Tip
posts.content: Win + Arrow keys for window snapping is a game changer! Win + Left/Right snaps to sides, Win + Up maximizes.

posts.title: AutoFilter Shortcut
posts.content: Ctrl + Shift + L toggles AutoFilter on/off. Essential for data analysis!

posts.title: Quick File Open
posts.content: Ctrl + P opens file search. Type @ to see symbols, # to search workspace, : to go to line number.

posts.title: Quick Search
posts.content: Win + S opens search instantly. No need to click the taskbar!

posts.title: Quick Symbols
posts.content: Alt + 0169 = ©, Alt + 0174 = ®, Alt + 0153 = ™. Memorize your frequently used symbols!
